2608.14015.title: MedClaw: Heuristic Agent Harness for Long-Horizon Surgical Video Reasoning
2608.14015.paper_summary: Understanding tens-of-minutes surgical videos requires long-horizon temporal reasoning, answering what happens before, after, or across stages of a procedure by grounding the question in visual evidence spread across time. Existing approaches handle this poorly: a one-shot vision-language model (VLM) compresses the whole procedure to fit its context window and loses the detail a "before" or "after" question depends on, while video agents that train the model where to look are data-hungry and transfer poorly to out-of-domain surgery. We build an agent harness that separates reasoning from perception and improves by evolving context rather than optimizing weights. A text-only orchestrator plans which evidence to gather and issues an auditable sequence of tool calls, while frozen vision-language sub-agents execute each call over the pixels, viewing, cropping, inspecting frames, and retrieving external knowledge. We further propose a gradient-free, reward-gated Heuristic Skill Distillation loop that mines the agent's own low-scoring traces and keeps a candidate skill only when it raises a validation reward, yielding reusable retrieval skills, notably directed re-look. Growing an external skill library rather than tuning weights, the loop adapts from only about 100 labeled examples, far fewer than supervised or reinforcement fine-tuning requires. To evaluate this agent, we introduce MedClawBench, a de-leaked, doctor-grounded benchmark of 1,123 questions over self-built long neurosurgery recordings and a held-out public lecture-video test split. Across both datasets and all four evaluation dimensions, our agent consistently outperforms one-shot VLMs and general video-agent frameworks, with the largest gains on the long, out-of-domain neurosurgery videos. Project page: https://fyycs.github.io/medclaw/.
2608.14015.paper_summary_zh: 理解數十分鐘的手術視頻需要長期的時間推理，回答在程序的不同階段之前、之後或跨越的事件，並將問題基於跨時間的視覺證據進行定位。現有的方法處理得很差：一個一次性視覺-語言模型（VLM）將整個程序壓縮以適應其上下文窗口，並失去了“之前”或“之後”問題所依賴的細節，而訓練模型查看位置的視頻代理則需要大量數據，並且在域外手術中轉移效果不佳。我們構建了一個代理鞍具，將推理與感知分開，並通過演變上下文而不是優化權重來改進。一個僅限文本的協調者計劃收集哪些證據並發出可審計的工具調用序列，而凍結的視覺-語言子代理則在像素上執行每個調用，查看、裁剪、檢查幀並檢索外部知識。我們進一步提出了一個無梯度、獎勵閘控的啟發式技能蒸餾循環，挖掘代理自身的低得分痕跡，並僅在其提高驗證獎勵時保留候選技能，從而產生可重用的檢索技能，特別是定向重新查看。這個循環通過增長外部技能庫而不是調整權重，從僅約100個標記示例中適應，遠少於監督或強化微調所需的數量。為了評估這個代理，我們引入了MedClawBench，一個去泄漏的、以醫生為基礎的基準，涵蓋了1,123個問題，基於自建的長期神經外科錄音和一個保留的公共講座視頻測試集。在這兩個數據集和所有四個評估維度中，我們的代理始終優於一次性VLM和一般視頻代理框架，並在長期的域外神經外科視頻上獲得了最大的增益。項目頁面：https://fyycs.github.io/medclaw/.
